title: Our tour guide Majid was...
text: Our tour guide Majid was so personal and experienced.  He treated us like family and made certain that we saw everything close up and that we had the best time.  The experience ended at the market place and although we bought something at the oils and spices area we could not buy a rug and that vendor seemed to feel  very bad that we would not buy from him.
author: adrian_b
